an8.5:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] aṭṭhime bhikkhave, loka dhammā lokaṃ anuparivattanti, loko ca aṭṭhalokadhamme anuparivattati.
an8.5:1.3: lābho ca alābho ca ayaso ca yaso ca nindā ca pasaṃsā ca sukhaṃ ca dukkhaṃ ca,
an8.5:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭhalokadhamme lokaṃ anuparivattanti, loko ca ime aṭṭhalokadhamme anuparivattatīti.
